business_problem: Vodafone wanted to improve customer service by overcoming the limits of traditional chatbots, which could usually answer only simple keyword-based questions and created weaker first-contact resolution and customer experience during complex enquiries.
solution_summary: Vodafone deployed SuperTOBi as a generative AI virtual assistant for customer service, powered by Microsoft Azure OpenAI and rolled out across European markets. Customer enquiries enter Vodafone’s online chat service, where SuperTOBi interprets full sentences and phrases instead of relying on simple keyword matching, then generates more natural responses for customer-facing journeys such as appointment booking and, increasingly, billing. When the assistant cannot resolve an issue, it automatically transfers the conversation to a human agent. Vodafone paired this with SuperAgent, based on Microsoft Azure OpenAI’s Agent Copilot solution, to support customer care employees: it searches Vodafone’s companywide private knowledge database for reliable answers to complex questions and sends conversation summaries to agents so customers do not need to repeat themselves. SuperSearch extends the same AI-driven search pattern to Vodafone’s public websites.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Azure OpenAI
solution_components.role: Provides the generative AI model capability that powers SuperTOBi and underpins Vodafone's agent-assist workflow.

solution_components.name: Agent Copilot
solution_components.role: Provides the foundation for SuperAgent to search for answers and assist human agents with complex customer queries.

solution_components.name: SuperTOBi
solution_components.role: Serves as Vodafone's customer-facing generative AI virtual assistant in online chat, handling complex enquiries and customer journeys such as appointment booking.

solution_components.name: SuperAgent
solution_components.role: Assists customer care employees by locating answers from Vodafone's private knowledge base and passing conversation summaries to agents.

solution_components.name: SuperSearch
solution_components.role: Provides improved AI-supported search on Vodafone's customer-facing websites.

data_flow: Customers submit questions through Vodafone's online chat, where SuperTOBi processes full-sentence enquiries using Microsoft Azure OpenAI and returns responses for tasks such as appointment booking. If an issue is unresolved, the interaction is handed to a human agent, while SuperAgent uses Agent Copilot to search Vodafone's private knowledge database and pass a conversation summary to the agent. Related answers are also exposed through SuperSearch on Vodafone websites.
business_outcome: Vodafone reported faster handling of complex enquiries, more personalized customer conversations, automatic escalation to human agents when needed, higher first-time resolution in Portugal, improved online net promoter scores, and reduced repetition for customers handed to agents in Ireland.
metrics: first-time resolution rate increased from 15% to 60%
online net promoter scores improved by 14 points to 64 points
TOBi is already supporting customers in 13 countries across Europe and Africa
architecture_clues: Rolled out in Italy and Portugal, with Germany and Turkey added from July 2024 and other markets to follow.
SuperTOBi is the next generation of TOBi, which already supports 13 countries and 11 languages.
SuperAgent uses only Vodafone's companywide and private knowledge database rather than public sources.
The program sits within a broader Vodafone customer experience transformation backed by a reallocated investment of €140 million.
